meta.title: WordPress Museum: 2.0 (Duke)
meta.description: A time-capsule post for WordPress 2.0, released December 31, 2005.
meta.author: wordpress-playground

steps.code:
<?php
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) {
	require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
}

global $wpdb;

function wordpress_museum_sql_escape($value) {
	return str_replace("'", "''", $value);
}

$title = wordpress_museum_sql_escape(base64_decode('TXVzZXVtIERpc3BhdGNoOiBXb3JkUHJlc3MgMi4wIChEdWtlKQ=='));
$content = wordpress_museum_sql_escape(base64_decode(''));
$slug = 'wordpress-museum-2-0';
$now = '2005-12-31 10:00:00';
$wpdb->query("UPDATE " . $wpdb->posts . " SET post_status = 'draft' WHERE ID = 1");
$wpdb->query(
	"INSERT INTO " . $wpdb->posts . " " .
	"(post_author, post_date, post_date_gmt, post_content, post_title, " .
	"post_category, post_excerpt, post_status, comment_status, ping_status, " .
	"post_password, post_name, to_ping, pinged, post_modified, " .
	"post_modified_gmt, post_content_filtered, post_parent, menu_order, " .
	"post_mime_type, comment_count) " .
	"VALUES (1, '$now', '$now', '$content', '$title', 1, '', 'publish', " .
	"'open', 'closed', '', '$slug', '', '', '$now', '$now', '', 0, 0, '', 0)"
);
